# Provenance

This distribution owns the acquisition functions, per-function guides and reusable collection
target metadata. It does not require a source-project checkout or operator-specific directory.

Guarded redirects, pinned connections, bounded reads, explicit browser dependencies, shared browser
request handling and read-only verification belong to the package. Acquired content receives its
own provenance record; acquisition alone never grants redistribution rights.

Collections contain URLs and source-selection notes, not publisher content or freshly acquired
holdings. Third-party material is not redistributed by installing this package.
